text: '일류경제도시 대전' (first-class economic city Daejeon) is a promotion slogan of Daejeon Metropolitan City: the city government's own press office headlines its own releases with it (e.g. '일류경제도시 대전, 경제성장률 껑충', 25 December 2024).
short: '일류경제도시 대전' is a Daejeon Metropolitan City promotion slogan.

source.name: 대전광역시청 (Daejeon Metropolitan City): 일류경제도시 대전, 경제성장률 껑충
